notes: «يا كعب بن مرة حدثنا»: Ka'b is asked to narrate and answers («قال سمعت رسول الله»), so he is the last link (rules 5 and 6)
the compiler's remark on a route through Mansur with an inserted unnamed man is a variant group, never a route (rules 4 and 8)
«ويقال مرة بن كعب» is a note on the Companion's name, left out
